```{r}
t2m_file <- "/g/data/fs38/publications/CMIP6/CMIP/CSIRO/ACCESS-ESM1-5/historical/r1i1p1f1/day/tas/gn/latest/*" |>
  Sys.glob() |>
  cmip_selantmerge()
```

```{r}
t2m_mean <- cdo_monmean(t2m_file)[]
t2m_sd <- cdo_monstd1(t2m_file)[]


anomsd <- cdo_monsub(t2m_file,t2m_mean) |> 
  cdo_mondiv(t2m_sd) |> 
  _[]

# Pow needs interactive 
t2m_skew <- anomsd |> 
  cdo_mul(anomsd) |> 
  cdo_mul(anomsd) |> 
  cdo_monmean() |> 
  _[]




t2m_sd <- cdo_monsk(t2m_file)[]


pct <- cdo_daypctl(t2m_file, cdo_ydaymin(t2m_file), cdo_ydaymax(t2m_file), p = 95)[]

t2m_posdays <- t2m_file |>
  cdo_gtc(-1.8 + 273.15) |>
  cdo_monmean() |>
  _[]
```

```{r}
ice <- "/g/data/fs38/publications/CMIP6/CMIP/CSIRO/ACCESS-ESM1-5/historical/r1i1p1f1/SImon/siconc/gn/latest/*" |>
  Sys.glob() |>
  cmip_selantmerge()
```

```{r}
ice_spacing <- 0.01 * 2
t2m_spacing <- 0.2 * 2
cut_ice <- \(x) cut_mid(x, ice_spacing / 2, 0.03)
cut_t2m <- \(x) cut_mid(x, t2m_spacing / 2, 0)
```

```{r}
t2m <- metR::ReadNetCDF(t2m_mean, c(t2m = "tas")) |>
  _[, t2m_sd := metR::ReadNetCDF(t2m_sd, "tas", out = "vector")[[1]]] |>
  _[,
    t2m_posdays := metR::ReadNetCDF(t2m_posdays, "tas", out = "vector")[[1]]
  ] |>
    _[,
    t2m_skew := metR::ReadNetCDF(t2m_skew, "tas", out = "vector")[[1]]
  ] |>
  _[, t2m := t2m - 273.15] |>
  _[, aice := metR::ReadNetCDF(ice, "siconc", out = "vector")[[1]] / 100] |>
  _[!is.na(aice)]
```

```{r}
t2m |>
  _[,
    .(t2m_skew = mean(t2m_skew, na.rm = TRUE), n = .N),
    by = .(t2m = cut_t2m(t2m))
  ] |> 
    ggplot(aes(t2m, t2m_skew)) +
    geom_line()
 
```

```{r}
label_to_number <- function(x) {
  levs <- utils::strcapture(
    r"([\[\(](-?\d+),(-?\d+)[\]\)])",
    levels(x),
    perl = TRUE,
    proto = list(low = integer(), high = integer())
  )

  number <- (levs$high + levs$low) / 2
  levels(x) <- number

  x |>
    as.character() |>
    as.numeric()
}
```

```{r}

t2m |>
  _[,
    .(
      obs = mean(t2m_posdays, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = mean(t2m_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = .N
    ),
    by = .(t2m = cut_t2m(t2m))
  ] |>
  _[n > 50] |>
  _[, normal := pnorm(-1.8, mean = t2m, sd = sd, lower.tail = FALSE)] |>
  _[,
    constant := pnorm(
      -1.8,
      mean = t2m,
      sd = mean(sd[t2m > -1.8], na.rm = TRUE),
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
  ] |>
  _[, .(t2m, obs, normal, constant)] |>
  melt(id.vars = "t2m") |>
  ggplot(aes(t2m, value)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = variable))
```

```{r}
top_and_bottom <- function(x, N) {
  n <- nrow(x)
  x[c(1:N, (n - N + 1):n)]
}


events <- t2m |>
  _[t2m %between% c(-21, -19) | t2m %between% c(0, 2)] |>
  _[, t2m_cat := ifelse(t2m < -5, "cold", "warm")] |>
  _[, top_and_bottom(.SD[order(t2m_sd)], 1), by = .(t2m_cat, time)] |>
  _[, top_and_bottom(.SD[order(t2m_sd)], 10), by = .(t2m_cat)] |>
  _[, sd_cat := ifelse(1:.N <= 10, "low", "high"), by = t2m_cat] |>
  _[, time := as.Date(time)] |>
  _[, event_id := 1:.N] |>
  _[,
    c("lon_event", "lat_event") := proj4::project(
      list(x, y),
      sic_projection,
      inverse = TRUE
    )
  ]
```

```{r}
t2m[, t2m_a := t2m - mean(t2m, na.rm = TRUE), by = .(x, y, month(time))]
```

```{r}
events[
  t2m_cat == "warm" & sd_cat == "high",
  .(time, t2m_cat, sd_cat, event_id, lon_event)
] |>
  _[event_id == event_id[1]] |>
  t2m[i = _, on = "time"] |>
  _[,
    c("lon", "lat") := proj4::project(
      list(x, y),
      sic_projection,
      inverse = TRUE
    )
  ] |>
  _[, lon := (lon - lon_event) %% 360] |>
  ggplot(aes(lon, lat)) +
  geom_raster(aes(fill = t2m_a)) +
  facet_wrap(~event_id)
```

```{r}
ranges <- list(
  as.character(events$time),
  as.character(events$time + lubridate::days_in_month(events$time) - 1)
) |>
  transpose()


events <- gadiera5::era5() |>
  _[aggregation %like% "monthly"] |>
  _[variable == "z"] |>
  gadiera5::set_date_range(ranges) |>
  gadiera5::get_files() |>
  _[, .(variable, file = unlist(files), event_id = as.integer(range_id))] |>
  _[events, on = "event_id"] |>
  _[,
    c("lon_event", "lat_event") := proj4::project(
      list(x, y),
      sic_projection,
      inverse = TRUE
    )
  ] |>
  _[,
    file := cdo_sellonlatbox(file, lon_event - 50, lon_event + 50, -90, -40)[],
    by = .(event_id, variable)
  ]
```


```{r}
events_composite <- events |>
  _[
    t2m_cat == "cold",
    ReadNetCDF(file, variable),
    by = .(t2m_cat, sd_cat, event_id, lon_event)
  ] |>
  normalise_names() |>
  _[, lon := x - floor(lon_event)] |>
  _[, .(z = mean(z)), by = .(lon, lat = y, t2m_cat, sd_cat)]
```

```{r}
events_composite |>
  copy() |>
  _[, z := z - mean(z), by = lat] |>
  ggplot(aes(lon, lat)) +
  geom_raster(aes(fill = z)) +
  facet_grid(t2m_cat ~ sd_cat)
```

```{r}
f <- \(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

f1 <- \(x) log(x / (1 - x))


x_mean <- -3
x_sd <- 0.1
B <- 1000

# The thing I would compute normally
f(x_mean)

# The actual effect 
rnorm(B, x_mean, x_sd) |> 
  f() |> 
  mean()

# The "effective temperature" that I would like to compute 
# based on x_mean, x_sd (and other possible moments) 
rnorm(B, x_mean, 0.001) |> 
  f() |> 
  mean() |> 
  f1()
```



```{r}
effecive_value <- function(mean, sd, f, f1, B) {
  rnorm(B, mean, sd) |>
    f() |>
    mean() |>
    f1()
}

CJ(
  mean = seq(-6, 0, length.out = 30),
  sd = exp(seq(log(0.001), log(3), length.out = 30))
) |>
  _[, eff := effecive_value(mean, sd, f, f1, 1000), by = .(mean, sd)] |>
  _[] |> 
  ggplot(aes(mean, sd)) +
  geom_contour_fill(aes(z = eff))
```
